name: SupplierFlow routing accuracy eval (SF-JEV-008)
notes: Multi-label intent expectations for the Laya decision router. Business facts are NOT asserted here; only which information kinds a correct retrieval plan needs. SKUs are real catalogue identifiers from data/supplierflow-official-knowledge.md. Ambiguous cases expect a clarification-capable plan (product_discovery, no exact lookup).
threshold_note: Thresholds are tuned by run-routing-eval.mjs --sweep, not assumed. Measured Jev (jev-latest, 2026-09-21): threshold 0.5 -> exact 70.8% / F1 92.4% / recall 98.2%; 0.6 -> 62.5% / 91.4% / 94.6%; 0.7 -> 70.8% / 92.9% / 92.9%. Default 0.5 kept for highest recall: missing an intent hurts retrieval, extra intents only add a cheap knowledge op.
